_doc: Composed-claim drop scenario. A Public 'account health story' claim whose derived_from chain includes a Confidential parent. On the AgentMcp audience (RenderSurface::McpTool), build_receipt_for_audience MUST return PrivacyError::ComposedClaimDropped — the chain max is Confidential, McpTool drops Confidential, and the derivation chain means a partial render would leak via inference.
rationale_acceptance_criterion: AC-341.10 mixed-sensitivity composed claims: sensitivity = max(inputs); if max exceeds surface, drop the entire composed claim (no partial render — prevents inference leaks).
